d:
Mehnat ki lut sabse khatarnak nahin hoti
Pulis ki mar sabse khatarnak nahin hoti
Gaddari aur lobh ki mutthi sabse khatarnak nahin hoti
Baithe-bithae pakre jana bura to hai
Sahmi-si chup men jakre jana bura to hai
Sabse khatarnak nahin hota
Kapat ke shor men sahi hote hue bhi dab jana bura to hai
Jugnuon ki lau men parhna
